**Chinese name:** 寒武纪科技股份有限公司 (Hánwǔjì Kējì Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Spun out of the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Institute of Computing Technology in March 2016; originally supplied AI silicon IP to Huawei before going independent, Cambricon is now one of China's most closely watched Nvidia-alternative plays, briefly becoming China's most valuable listed company by market cap.
:::

## What does this firm design?

AI accelerator chips spanning cloud training/inference and edge inference, positioned as a domestic substitute as US export controls restrict Nvidia GPU access in China.
